units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Morning. You're in Brussels, and you've got a day.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And I'm Ben. We're going to give you fifteen minutes of context, so that everything you walk past today means something.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Think of it as the briefing before the mission.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Exactly that. Three things to know about the city, five things worth seeing, and one thing to do if it rains.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Okay. Start me off. What is this place?
